auth.recovery_body: For safety, CareCircle does not allow insecure email-only passcode resets. If you lose your passcode, ask your circle's elder (or verify ownership via an administrator-assisted identity check in production) to revoke old access and issue a fresh invitation.

circle.heading: Care Circle, Members & Consent
circle.invite_care_contact: Designate as Care Contact (can acknowledge alerts)
circle.quiet_hours_enabled: Enable quiet hours (suppresses non-critical automatic contact escalation)
circle.elder_quiet_reminders: Continue elder reminders during quiet hours
circle.emergency_country: Country / Region (for local emergency number display)
circle.ai_consent_label: Allow optional Gemini AI assistance on minimal anonymized/de-identified circle data
circle.ai_consent_disclosure: Before enabling AI: only minimal text/schedule snippets needed for the requested assist are sent to Google Gemini. Names, emails, and contact numbers are omitted. Core CareCircle features work fully without AI.
circle.delete_circle_warning: CareCircle retains active clinical records until archived or deleted by the elder. Deleting a circle removes member access immediately and schedules purge of circle records.

about.heading: About CareCircle & Medical Disclaimer
about.mission: CareCircle is an elder-centered medication and care coordination platform designed around autonomy, respectful Care Chain escalation, and clear English/Hindi access.
about.medical_disclaimer_body: CareCircle supports coordination and recordkeeping only. It does not provide medical advice, clinical diagnosis, or treatment recommendations, and it does not replace a clinician, pharmacist, or emergency services.
